reproduction.fixture: Invented two-run S/T candidate schedule, existing actas, blind manifest and two primary ratings per opaque artifact.
reproduction.baseline_false_green: With an acta dated after the first declared Q lock, the old checker verified both records because it only required preparation after the terminal attempt and did not open ratings.
reproduction.current_rule: For each opaque ID, terminal ended_at_utc < acta prepared_at_utc < earliest declared primary or adjudicator outcome-stage lock; the full rating document and its canonical digest must match the private map.
current_negative_controls: An acta before terminal end, equal to the first lock or after that lock yields record_chronology_mismatch.
Changed ratings with an unchanged mapping digest yield mapping_document_mismatch.
reproduction.current_positive_control: The two valid actas pass the private checker and the corresponding blind ratings assemble into two scored Q rows.

limits: The test dates, actas, ratings and judges are invented; timestamps are claims and the checker is a local read-only check.
The checker does not authenticate custody, independent preparation, transformation, terminal and blind bytes or actual score-lock time.
Forging map, ratings and actas together can pass; no reserved model comparison was run.
